strings.settings.title: Settings
strings.settings.saved: Changes are saved to alchemist.ini automatically.
strings.settings.usePlayerStatsDescription: Includes Alchemy skill, perks, and worn Fortify Alchemy equipment.
strings.settings.singleThreadedDescription: Disable this option to use the multithreaded calculation path.
strings.settings.cacheDurationDescription: How long to keep master recipe cache in memory after closing the alchemy menu (default 180s).
strings.settings.staleThresholdDescription: If calculation took longer than this, defer recalculations during crafting and show manual Recalculate button (default 500ms).
strings.settings.debounceDescription: Delay before running background recalculation after rapid crafting clicks (default 400ms).
strings.settings.filterSelectedDescription: Show only potions made from ingredients currently selected in the Skyrim alchemy menu. With no ingredients selected, all potions are shown.
strings.settings.protectIngredientsDescription: Ingredients are protected only while this option is checked.
strings.settings.noAvailableIngredients: No available ingredients match the search.
strings.settings.prefixDescription: Prefixes are applied to beneficial potion and harmful poison names.
